description: Governor - Northern Province - Livelihood Management Services (LMS) Statute No. 1 of 2022 - Northern Province Tourism Bureau Statute No. 2 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a provincial statute (Livelihood Management Services Statute No. 1 of 2022) that establishes a regulatory framework for livelihood management services in the Northern Province. It outlines the legal authority, objectives, powers, functions, and management structure of the new statutory body, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or organizational change.
